title: Reading
description: The three Reading task types — Complete the Words, Read in Daily Life and Read an Academic Passage — plus skimming, scanning and paraphrase strategies.

id.title: Reading
id.description: Tiga tipe soal Reading — Complete the Words, Read in Daily Life dan Read an Academic Passage — serta strategi skimming, scanning dan parafrase.

nodes.title: Complete the Words
nodes.summary: Fill in the missing letters of words in a short academic text using grammar and context.

objectives.text: Identify the missing part of a word from the letters shown and the meaning of the sentence
Choose the correct word form (tense, plural, part of speech) for the gap

id.title: Complete the Words
id.summary: Melengkapi huruf yang hilang pada kata-kata dalam teks akademik pendek dengan bantuan tata bahasa dan konteks.

objectives.word-from-context: Menentukan bagian kata yang hilang dari huruf yang ditampilkan dan makna kalimat
objectives.grammar-form: Memilih bentuk kata yang benar (tenses, jamak, kelas kata) untuk bagian yang kosong
objectives.spelling-accuracy: Mengeja kata akademik umum dengan benar

nodes.title: Read in Daily Life
nodes.summary: Understand short everyday texts such as notices, emails, menus and social media posts.

objectives.text: Identify the main purpose of a short everyday text
Find key details such as times, places and conditions
Infer what the writer implies but does not state directly

id.title: Read in Daily Life
id.summary: Memahami teks sehari-hari yang pendek seperti pengumuman, email, menu dan unggahan media sosial.

objectives.text-purpose: Menentukan tujuan utama teks sehari-hari yang pendek
objectives.key-details: Menemukan detail penting seperti waktu, tempat dan syarat
objectives.implied-meaning: Menyimpulkan maksud penulis yang tidak dinyatakan secara langsung

nodes.title: Read an Academic Passage
nodes.summary: Answer questions on a short university-style passage: main idea, details, vocabulary and inference.

objectives.text: Identify the main idea of an academic passage
Locate supporting details and pronoun referents
Work out the meaning of a word from context
Recognise how ideas are organised (cause–effect, compare–contrast)

id.title: Read an Academic Passage
id.summary: Menjawab soal tentang teks pendek bergaya kuliah: gagasan utama, detail, kosakata dan inferensi.

objectives.supporting-details: Menemukan detail pendukung dan rujukan kata ganti

nodes.title: Skimming, Scanning & Paraphrase
nodes.summary: Read faster and choose answers that restate the text in different words.

objectives.text: Skim for the gist and scan for a specific detail within a time limit
Match a correct answer option to the paraphrased sentence in the text
Eliminate distractors that are too broad, too narrow or not stated

id.title: Skimming, Scanning & Parafrase
id.summary: Membaca lebih cepat dan memilih jawaban yang menyatakan ulang isi teks dengan kata-kata berbeda.

objectives.skim-scan: Membaca sekilas (skimming) untuk inti dan memindai (scanning) untuk detail tertentu dalam batas waktu
objectives.spot-paraphrase: Mencocokkan pilihan jawaban yang benar dengan kalimat parafrasenya di teks
objectives.eliminate-distractors: Menyingkirkan pengecoh yang terlalu luas, terlalu sempit atau tidak disebutkan
